verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at developer.mastercard.com (HTTP 200), and the Open Finance docs are served as agent-friendly index.md markdown pages. Mastercard's Agent Toolkit docs also state that developers can point AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor at its docs for answers pulled from the source. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of agent use, and explicit evidence that the platform-wide llms.txt indexes the Open Finance section specifically.
